elder.name: Elder Sora
lines: Ah, a young ninja! I have been expecting you.
Our village needs a hero, and you carry the name Mega-Ninja.
Look around the village, then come back and see me. Your journey begins soon.

farmer.name: Farmer
lines: Welcome to the farm! The soil here is perfect for wheat.
I am always short on help. Come back soon, I will have work for you.
repeatLines: The fields are coming along. Come back soon.
